messages:
Sophie: Quick morning smoke on the train — overall green but one cherry failed merge on staging, breaking a GPU test :thinking_face:
Ryan: which cherry and what's the error? can you paste the CI log? :eyes:
Sophie: PR #3221 (kv-cache-prefetch) failed with `CUDA OOM` on the nvidia-gpu-2 runner. log shows `OutOfMemoryError during attentn_layer` — looks like sequence-length regression after a model tweak. link: https://gh.redwood/pr/3221 :link:
Liam: that PR bumped default max_seq from 2048 -> 4096, fwiw. I saw flakiness locally when running batching with longer prefixes.
Jen: I can take the cherry. if it's just the default seq bump we can revert the change in the cherry and re-run smoke. pinging @Sophie for the exact cherry branch name.
Sophie: cherry branch is `release/2026-03-kv-prefetch-cherry`. To revert quickly:
```bash
# revert cherry locally
git fetch origin release/2026-03
git checkout -b release/2026-03-kv-prefetch-cherry-revert
git revert --no-edit <commit-sha>
gh pr create --title "revert: kv-cache-prefetch seq bump" --body "revert for release" --base release/2026-03
```
Sasha: also want to run the lightweight canary smoke while Jen reverts. run this on the canary pool to verify latency/cost baseline: `./scripts/smoke_check.sh --train release-2026-03 --canary`
Sophie: spawned canary run — DeployBot will post results. Jen, if you can open the revert PR I'll queue it for merge once CI passes.
DeployBot: Canary run started for release-2026-03 on pool `canary-small-gpu` at 2026-03-17T09:02:30Z.
DeployBot: Canary health: 98% (latency p95 within threshold, 3 ephemeral pod restarts observed). Logs: https://ci.redwood/canary/2110003210
Ryan: sounds ok. if canary looks stable and revert fixes the OOM we can rollforward. any blockers for the revert?
Jen: opening PR now. should be up in ~10m. assigning @Liam for a quick CR (since he touched seq defaults).
Liam: will review asap. if tests are flaky we can add a temporary guard for max_seq via env var rather than changing default.
Sophie: plan: 1) Jen opens revert PR 2) run canary smoke 3) if pass, merge and do a quick linear rollout 4) keep an eye on kv-cache metrics. I'll update this thread with CI/canary results. :thumbsup:
Ryan: thanks. small ask — call out in the changelog that default seq change is behind env flag for next patch. easier for ops.
Sophie: noted. will add to PR description.
Jen: PR created: https://gh.redwood/pr/3245 — title: "revert: kv-cache-prefetch default seq bump". CI queued.
DeployBot: CI for PR #3245 started (unit + integration).
Sophie: thanks team. keeping this on the morning watchlist. I'll post final status once CI + canary finish. :coffee:
